s1.syndrome_frame: Acute neurological presentation with seizure and altered mental status
salient_findings: Diffuse bilateral cortical and subcortical edema on brain imaging
key_facts: Presented to the emergency department after a seizure
History of left cerebral ischemic stroke and myocardial infarction 4 months ago
Used synthetic cannabis before the seizure
Normal complete blood cell count, chemistry panel, aspirin level, acetaminophen level, alcohol level, and liver function tests
Urine drug screen positive for cannabinoids

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute neurological presentation with seizure and altered mental status
salient_findings: Diffuse bilateral cortical and subcortical edema on brain imaging
key_facts: Presented to the emergency department after a seizure
History of left cerebral ischemic stroke and myocardial infarction 4 months ago
Used synthetic cannabis before the seizure
Normal complete blood cell count, chemistry panel, aspirin level, acetaminophen level, alcohol level, and liver function tests
Urine drug screen positive for cannabinoids

differentials: Mitochondrial encephalomyopathy, lactic acidosis, and stroke-like episodes
Primary angiitis of the central nervous system
Cerebral autosomal dominant arteriopathy with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy
per_call: Mitochondrial encephalomyopathy, lactic acidosis, and stroke-like episodes
Primary angiitis of the central nervous system
Cerebral autosomal dominant arteriopathy with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy

shortlist.label: Synthetic cannabinoid receptor agonist-induced toxicity
shortlist.why_kept: Patient used synthetic cannabis before the seizure and has a history of similar substance use leading to cerebral ischemic stroke and myocardial infarction

shortlist.label: Toxic encephalopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's presentation with seizure, altered mental status, and diffuse bilateral cortical and subcortical edema is consistent with toxic encephalopathy, particularly given the positive urine drug screen for cannabinoids

shortlist.label: Cerebral vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of cerebral ischemic stroke and current presentation with seizure and altered mental status could be indicative of an underlying vasculitis process

shortlist.label: Reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's presentation with seizure, headache, and altered mental status, along with the use of synthetic cannabis, could be consistent with reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome

shortlist.label: Status epilepticus
shortlist.why_kept: Patient had two tonic-clonic seizures, which is consistent with status epilepticus, and the underlying cause may be related to the synthetic cannabinoid use or another underlying condition

raw.rationale: The patient's history of using synthetic cannabis before the seizure and the presence of diffuse bilateral cortical and subcortical edema on brain imaging studies support this diagnosis, as synthetic cannabinoids are known to cause severe neurological effects including seizures and cerebral edema.

rejected.label: Toxic encephalopathy
rejected.why: While the patient has encephalopathy, the specific link to synthetic cannabinoid use makes Synthetic cannabinoid receptor agonist-induced toxicity a more precise diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cerebral vasculitis
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence of inflammation or vasculitis on the provided imaging studies or laboratory tests.

rejected.label: Reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's presentation and imaging findings do not specifically suggest reversible vasoconstriction, and the temporal relationship with synthetic cannabis use points more directly to its toxic effects.

rejected.label: Status epilepticus
rejected.why: Although the patient had seizures, status epilepticus is more a description of the seizure activity itself rather than an underlying cause, which in this case appears to be related to synthetic cannabinoid use.
